svg.title: SealedVoice architecture and insider blocked paths
svg.desc: Design overview: browser encryption, ciphertext server, TideCloak quorum and Forseti on ORKs. Red crosses indicate intended enforcement points, not recorded live results. Browser trust, metadata and deletion remain limits. Lettering is outlined; no external font is required.

g.aria-label: One report. Separate authority at every layer.
Design overview. Real ORK / QEA outcomes must be verified separately.
Trusted browser required. Metadata and IP remain visible. Deletion / withholding is not prevented.
